title: Yusef Lateef as Bill Evans: praying toward the sun on the bus
summary: Evans, studying Muslim ideas, asks the bus to stop at five o'clock to face the sun.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Now, would you like to say anything special about Yusef Lateef, who was Bill Evans then?
Yeah, his name was Bill Evans. We mentioned him before and he brought Julius Watkins, and he was another guy-- I tell you what though, he was studying but he

Muslim-minded then and he was very sincere and if you were ever around at five o'clock, they have to turn to the sun and pray, and he had a quiet concern (inaudible), he would ask me if it would be all right for the bus to stop and he would face the sun.
Yeah, that was it. And so a few years after he had left the band he became Yusef.
He was here in Omaha in 1948.
He ran a band called Bob Nora, and he was the bandleader, more or less. He had a new Desoto limousine and I got to know him well.
I was a little surprised to learn that Bill Evans was Yusef Lateef.
Now, would you like to go on "In The Mood?"
